statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat that have persisted for several weeks.
A 48-hour Holter monitor (CPT 93226) has been ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic recording.
The service addresses diagnoses I49.9 and R00.2.
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204.
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan.
